extracted.summary: Elena is a litigant in person in divorce proceedings seeking around £54,000 to fund legal representation, with matrimonial assets (house and pension) worth about £970,000.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for contacting Lodestar Legal Finance about funding for your divorce. We have noted that you are currently representing yourself, that you are seeking around £54,000, and that the assets in dispute are valued at approximately £970,000. To take this further we would need to know where the proceedings have been issued, the stage they have reached and any upcoming hearing dates, details of the solicitor you would instruct if funding were in place, and some information on the assets and how they are held. A member of the team will review your enquiry and come back to you with any further questions.
